sections.title: Why This Distinction Exists
sections.content:
An earlier wave of pre-launch write-ups listed four playable characters for this game - Soul, Mu Xiaokui, Zuo Shang and The Chord. That roster belongs to S-Game's mobile entries, where those names are playable together. It was never announced for Phantom Blade Zero.

The likeliest source of the confusion is the music: composer Caisheng Bo confirmed that Soul, Mu Xiaokui and Zuoshang each have their own thematic melody, all descended from the same A minor theme. Three leitmotifs reads like three playable characters. It is not. See is Phantom Blade Zero single-player.
